title: DynamicSideContent
description: Fiori dynamic side content: main and side content laid out by the control's width (S/M/L/XL), side position, fall-down, equal split and toggle (ui5-dynamic-side-content).

usage.summary: Keep supplementary context beside or below the main task without covering its content.
useWhen: Consult relevant supporting information while completing a task that remains possible without the side content.
Let supporting content move below the main area as the container narrows instead of overlaying it.
At widths of 720px or less, provide a toggleContents() trigger for hidden side content, or set sideContentVisibility="alwaysShow" to keep it below the main area.

avoidWhen.when: Navigate between a record list, selected object and related sub-object as separate pages.
Place application navigation beside page content under a shared header.
Show essential object attributes or finalizing actions that users must access to complete the task.
